annotations.title: Verify up to 10 quote and URL citations in one call

description: Checks up to 10 quote and URL pairs on live pages: exact, fuzzy or none, one receipt. US$0.10 per call; POST pairs. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.10 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/verify-citations

citations.quote: These domains may be used as illustrative examples in documents

case_sensitive.description: Default false; must be false with match "passages".

citations.description: 1 to 10 citations. Each URL is fetched once however many quotes cite it. Dead domains are reported as results; if none resolves, 422 and no charge.

quote.description: Text the answer says is on that page, or with match "passages" the claim it says the page supports (max 1,000 characters after normalisation).

url.description: http(s) URL of the cited page (max 2,048 characters).

match.description: For every citation: exact; fuzzy (default), which also accepts small differences; or passages, for a paraphrased claim: the 3 passages that share most of its words, scored, as evidence for you to judge (not a verdict).

name: attestpage_verify_citations

pages.description: One entry per distinct URL: page verdict and evidence, including server_ip, tls and headers (also signed into the receipt). A page with a DOI also has crossref: { doi, doi_source, status (found, not_found or skipped), title, authors, year, container_title, type, retracted, updates, update_to } from Crossref.

results.description: One entry per citation, in request order: the match verdict (with match "passages": passages [{ start, end, score, text, missing, flags }] and scorer), or error (match_too_costly) for that citation alone (on a PDF the match and each passage also give pdf_page and pdf_page_end, 1-based), plus its page's final_url, http_status and content_kind; page indexes pages.

summary.description: Counts of exact, fuzzy, none (and passages) verdicts, failed citations, retracted: citations whose page DOI Crossref marks retracted, and doi_unchecked: citations whose page DOI lookup was skipped (busy, rate limited, timed out), so not checked.

title: Verify up to 10 quote and URL citations in one call
